# Movie Database

> A full-stack movie discovery and social platform. Browse trending films, build a personal watchlist, read and write community reviews, and get AI-powered recommendations.

## Features

- Browse trending, popular, and latest movie releases sourced from TMDB
- Personal watchlist with add/remove and sorting
- Community reviews with likes and helpful votes
- AI-powered movie recommendations via Google Gemini
- AI Matchmaker chatbot for personalised suggestions
- User profiles with social following and follower counts
- Notification centre for social activity
- Where to Watch — streaming and rental provider availability by region
- Shareable review and profile links
- Genre preference onboarding for personalised rails
- Light and dark theme

## Tech Stack

- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, motion/react
- Backend: Node.js, Express (serverless via Vercel)
- Authentication: Firebase Authentication
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL with Row Level Security)
- Movie data: TMDB API
- AI: Google Gemini API

## Notes

This application is a portfolio project. It is not affiliated with Netflix, TMDB, or any movie studio.
Movie metadata and images are provided by The Movie Database (TMDB) API.
